title: Recording: Brown Eyed Handsome Man, No Other Baby, She Said Yeah, Blue Jean Bop by Paul McCartney | 1999
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

The fifth of seven recording sessions for Paul McCartney’s Run Devil Run album took place on 5 March 1999.

Each of the sessions took place at Abbey Road Studios – the first five in March 1999, and a final two in May.

On this day four songs are known to have been recorded: ‘Brown Eyed Handsome Man’, ‘No Other Baby’, ‘She Said Yeah’, and ‘Blue Jean Bop’.

McCartney was accompanied by guitarists David Gilmour and Mick Green, pianist Geraint Watkins, and drummer Dave Mattacks.

The other Run Devil Run sessions took place on 1, 2, 3, and 4 March, and 4 and 5 May 1999.

Page last updated: 8 October 2021
